narr: Several episodes of heavy rain lead to several instances of flash flooding.
ev: Water over the road on Nine Mile and Gales Creek Road.
Water over the road at McCabe Road and Highway 70.
Water on Arendell Street between 19th and 22nd Streets.
Flooding at 15th Street and Bridges Street.
Car stalled in high water with an active water assist near the intersection of Queen Street and Plaza Boulevard. Relayed via social media.
Portions of Vernon Ave are closed due to flooding in the city of Kinston.
Multiple side streets and back roads within the town of Kinston are flooded and impassable with several cars stuck or stalled out. Relayed via social media.
Water covering roadways near the Kinston Fire Station No 1 at the corner of E Vernon Ave and East St. Water was over half way up car hubcaps in spots.
Report of water over roadway along Friendship Church Rd 1200 block as thunderstorms were moving through the area.
Picture from social media showed standing water in neighborhood backyards around State Electric Supply on Hwy 11.
There was flooding at Laurel Road and Merrimon Road.
